lessons.correction: Strengthen ground forces while increasing economy and expansion. Maintain defense and continue production.
lessons.mistake: Over-committing to a single ground tech path without scouting, potentially neglecting defense against possible pressure.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate when the opponent's army composition or posture changes, or when you reach a new tech tier.
lessons.title: Ground Commitment vs. Balanced Expansion
lessons.when: Early-midgame (around 4 minutes) when both players have heavy economy and tech, and the opponent shows a ground posture with Stalkers.
lessons.why: The opponent is ground-focused, so reinforcing your ground army and expanding your economy will set up a strong midgame. Heavy technology investment supports future transitions.

lessons.correction: Continue strengthening ground forces and maintain economy and expansion. Keep technology development ongoing.
lessons.mistake: Over-committing to a single tech path without scouting, or neglecting defense against possible pressure.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate if the opponent transitions to air or if you need to adjust your composition.
lessons.title: Matching Ground Strength
lessons.when: Midgame (around 8 minutes) when both players have heavy economies and tech, and the opponent shows a ground posture with Zealots, Stalkers, Sentries, and Immortals.
lessons.why: The opponent's ground composition is strong, so matching with a robust ground army and maintaining tech advantages will keep you competitive.

lessons.correction: Increase air presence and strengthen air forces while continuing economy and technology development.
lessons.mistake: Over-committing to air without sufficient ground support, or neglecting economy.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate if the opponent transitions to air or if your air investment is not paying off.
lessons.title: Air Harassment Against Ground
lessons.when: Early-midgame (around 5 minutes) when the opponent shows a ground posture with Stalkers, but you have a mixed army with Oracles and a heavy economy.
lessons.why: The opponent is ground-focused, so adding air units like Oracles can provide harassment and scouting advantages while you build a mixed composition.
